paper_metadata.title: Microstructural and mechanical properties of novel b-type Ti–Nb–Ni alloys containing a second phase

evidence.quote: The microstructure and mechanical properties of novel b-type Ti74-xNb26Nix (x = 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24 at.%) alloys with a low Young’s modulus and containing different amounts of a second phase (Ti 2Ni and Ni 3Nb) were investigated.
